verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents several first-party natural-language interfaces. You can chat in the PR to ask follow-ups, challenge recommendations, or prompt it to generate improvements (docs-6, docs-52, docs-62). You can teach it review preferences through natural-language chat (docs-7, docs-51). Change Stack chat answers questions about a change (docs-55), and a Slack agent handles natural-language investigation, planning and code editing (docs-19, docs-27). Claude Code can also trigger CodeRabbit reviews through simple commands (docs-17). Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably (the only community mention says it 'supposedly' remembers feedback), and evidence that configuration or admin tasks can be driven by natural language rather than keyword @coderabbitai commands and YAML.
